title: Zainabam
body:
tanhaai-e-man
man zulfiqar-e-hyderam
man aitbaar-e-khwaharam
man zainabam
<<DIVIDER>>
ay shaamiyon mai binte nabi binte ali hoon
zainab hoon mai zainab hoon mai zainab hoon mai
quran ke saaye may pali hoon
zakhmi hoon azadar hoon rassi may bandhi hoon
main phir bhi na zaalim se dari thi na dari hoon
<<DIVIDER>>
tanhaai e man
man charagh-e-mustafa
man jalaal-e-murtaza
man shakista zainabam
man zainabam
<<DIVIDER>>
man zulfiqar-e-hyderam
man aitbaar-e-khwaharam
man zainabam
<<DIVIDER>>
naize pe mere bhai ka sar tum ne chadhaya
turbat may ali aur nabi ko hai rulaaya
jitna bhi sataana tha hamay tum ne sataya
par bayyat-e-zaalim pe na sar hum ne jhukaya
<<DIVIDER>>
tanhaai e man
man charagh-e-mustafa
man jalaal-e-murtaza
man shakista zainabam
man zainabam
<<DIVIDER>>
man zulfiqar-e-hyderam
man aitbaar-e-khwaharam
man zainabam
<<DIVIDER>>
hai akbar o shabbir se abbas se waada
jab bhi dar e zindan e sitam mujhpe khulega
matam mere pyaron ka bapa shaam may hoga
phir matam-e-shabbir na ta hashr rukega
<<DIVIDER>>
tanhaai e man
man charagh-e-mustafa
man jalaal-e-murtaza
man shakista zainabam
man zainabam
<<DIVIDER>>
man zulfiqar-e-hyderam
man aitbaar-e-khwaharam
man zainabam
<<DIVIDER>>
paigham-e-hussaini ka diya jalta rahega
abbas ka parcham bhi har ek ghar may lagega
salman o ali jee azakhana to sajega
aelaan sada khutba-e-zainab ye karega
<<DIVIDER>>
tanhaai e man
man charagh-e-mustafa
man jalaal-e-murtaza
man shakista zainabam
man zainabam
<<DIVIDER>>
